name: Sega Genesis / Mega Drive
significance: Created the iconic 16-bit console war, dismantled Nintendo's near-monopoly in North America, and fostered an older demographic for video games.

verifiedFactualData.ram: 64 KB work RAM, 64 KB video RAM, 8 KB audio RAM

editorialContent.overview: The high-speed 16-bit arcade powerhouse that famously challenged Nintendo's monopoly with 'Blast Processing' and attitude.
